Ledger-First direction

Your money app should know which items were yours.

Trezzit stores every receipt as BillItem rows and every person's portion as ItemShare.share_amount, so splitting, budgeting, categories, and AI answers all use the same item-level truth.

Every item you assign to yourself flows into your personal expense ledger, tagged by category.

One model

One data model, four product surfaces.

Trezzit stores the line item, the person, the amount, and the category at the same level of detail. That lets the app split by item, categorize by item, budget by your share, and answer AI questions without translating a group receipt into a fake personal transaction.

Proof

The ledger table.

A group dinner becomes rows small enough to preserve reality: Maya shares the pizza, you own the tiramisu, and the wine can split four ways. The category status sits beside the share that will later power personal finance and AI answers.

Split engine

Splitting is per item, not per bill.

One receipt can mix equal, percentage, exact, shares, and adjusted methods because split_type lives on the ItemShare row. The UI reflects that: each item has its own split control and participant rows.

Personal finance

Personal expenses without lying.

A transaction tracker sees who paid. Trezzit can see what you consumed. Your grocery run, coffee, dessert, tax, and tip can all roll up from ItemShare.share_amount instead of treating the whole receipt as yours.

Receipt AI

Receipt AI with validation.

Receipt scanning is an input, not the product. Trezzit extracts line items, checks that prices reconcile, keeps review visible, then saves the result into the same ledger model used by balances and AI tools.

Merchant, date, line items, tax, and total are parsed into structured fields.

MCP

MCP for the ledger.

An AI agent can ask for expenses, balances, bill details, or settlement creation through real MCP tools. Read and write scopes are separate, and write activity is attributed to the agent that created it.

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "get_expenses",
    "arguments": {
      "group_id": "cabin-trip",
      "category": "Food",
      "date_from": "2026-05-01"
    }
  },
  "id": 42
}

Migration

Migration and groups.

Splitwise CSV import is a guided migration: Upload, Group, You, Map, Done. Once the group exists, balances are pre-aggregated for fast reads and the group currency stays locked so the math stays explicit.
